description: Build script for setting up dependencies, cloning repositories, building components, and preparing headers for an embedded services project, primarily focused on environment setup and project build automation.

methods.name: apt update
methods.description: Updates the package list on a Debian-based system.

methods.name: apt install
methods.description: Installs specified system dependencies and development libraries.

methods.name: pip install
methods.description: Installs Python packages required for the build environment.

methods.name: git clone
methods.description: Clones external repositories needed for the project.

methods.name: meson setup
methods.description: Configures the build environment for the 'trower-base64' project.

methods.name: ninja
methods.description: Build system used to compile and install the 'trower-base64' project.

methods.name: cmake
methods.description: Configures and builds CMake-based projects such as ThunderTools, Thunder, and entservices-apis.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Applies patches to source code as part of build customization.

methods.name: touch
methods.description: Creates empty header files to satisfy build dependencies.

methods.name: ls
methods.description: Lists directory contents, used here for verification.

methods.name: cp
methods.description: Copies headers and other files into the build environment.
